External Communication

Gia nhập đoàn tàu

Instruction or request for a vessel to assemble and proceed as part of an organized convoy for mutual safety, security, or navigation, under VTS or naval coordination.

Quick answer: Instruction or request for a vessel to assemble and proceed as part of an organized convoy for mutual safety, security, or navigation, under VTS or naval coordination.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

What is Gia nhập đoàn tàu?

In this glossary, Gia nhập đoàn tàu refers to: Instruction or request for a vessel to assemble and proceed as part of an organized convoy for mutual safety, security, or navigation, under VTS or naval coordination.

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tàu Romeo, gia nhập đoàn tàu tại trạm hoa tiêu lúc 0700 UTC. Duy trì tốc độ và chờ hướng dẫn từ trưởng đoàn."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Instruction or request for a vessel to assemble and proceed as part of an organized convoy for mutual safety, security, or navigation, under VTS or naval coordination.

Operational example

Vessel Romeo, join convoy at pilot station at 0700 UTC. Maintain speed and await instructions from convoy leader.

Localized term
